mag_sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the environmental sample from which the MAG was derived.

mag_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metagenome-assembled genome (MAG).

environmental_source.descr: Source environment of the sample, such as soil, freshwater, marine sediment, wastewater, host-associated, or other controlled vocabulary term.

sample_location.descr: Sampling location description or geographic label (e.g., site name, station, biome).

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees.

collection_date.descr: Date when the environmental sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters, where applicable (e.g., water column, sediment core, soil depth).

sequencing_platform_short_read.descr: Short-read sequencing platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, or MiSeq.

sequencing_platform_long_read.descr: Long-read sequencing platform used, such as Oxford Nanopore or PacBio.

short_read_library_prep.descr: Library preparation protocol used for short-read sequencing, including kit name if available.

long_read_library_prep.descr: Library preparation protocol used for long-read sequencing, including kit name if available.

short_read_trim_tool.descr: Software tool used for trimming short reads (e.g., Trimmomatic, fastp).

short_read_trim_parameters.descr: Key parameters used for short-read trimming, recorded as a machine-readable text string.

long_read_filter_tool.descr: Software tool used for filtering or trimming long reads before assembly.

long_read_filter_parameters.descr: Key parameters used for long-read filtering or correction, recorded as a machine-readable text string.

error_correction_tool.descr: Software tool used for read error correction prior to assembly.

error_correction_parameters.descr: Key parameters used during error correction, recorded as a machine-readable text string.

assembly_tool.descr: Primary software used to assemble the MAG, such as MEGAHIT, metaSPAdes, Flye, or hybrid assemblers.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters used by the assembler, recorded as a machine-readable text string.

hybrid_assembly.descr: Indicates whether both short-read and long-read data were used in the same assembly workflow.

binning_tool.descr: Software used to bin assembled contigs into MAGs, if applicable.

binning_parameters.descr: Key parameters used for genome binning, recorded as a machine-readable text string.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated completeness of the MAG as a percentage (0-100), typically derived from single-copy marker genes.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated contamination of the MAG as a percentage (0-100), typically derived from single-copy marker genes.

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity within the bin, expressed as a percentage where reported.

assembly_n50_bp.descr: Assembly N50 statistic in base pairs.

assembly_total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length in base pairs.

number_of_contigs.descr: Number of contigs in the final MAG assembly.

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the largest contig in the final MAG assembly, in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the MAG assembly as a percentage.

taxonomy_assignment.descr: Taxonomic assignment of the MAG, ideally using a standardized taxonomy string.

taxonomy_method.descr: Method or database used to assign taxonomy to the MAG.

functional_annotation_tool.descr: Software or pipeline used to annotate genes and infer functional potential.

functional_annotation_database.descr: Reference database used for functional annotation, such as KEGG, eggNOG, Pfam, or InterPro.

sample_biodiversity_context.descr: Brief description of the ecological or biodiversity context motivating the MAG analysis.

functional_potential_summary.descr: Short free-text summary of notable metabolic or ecological functions inferred for the MAG.
